notes: Family Admin → Family: the calendar and family tiles come first, then the points cards – each child now has its own “Set up points” link
Family Admin → Settings → System → Licence shows your whole licence key once it’s been entered, with a Copy button
Setup is simpler: no Apps Script API switch – publish once with Deploy → New deployment, and the script keeps itself up to date
Fewer Google permissions: the script no longer asks to manage Apps Script projects and deployments
